title: Easy to maintain, cat scratches less
text:
Easy to maintain, cat scratches less. I love these! Our cats have destroyed our couches. I refuse to buy new couches for this very reason. They scratch less now that the covers are on too. I love that they are easy to clean, just throw them in the washing machine. Also very easy to put on with just 1 person and have tags to direct you were each side need a to go.

Con: The little foam inserts don't help the cover stay in place, it does need to be tucked back in each time someone sits on them. Not a big deal to me
